title: Investors Turn to Emerging Market Debt Amid Yield Volatility | Insight with Haslinda Amin 9/7/2026
description:
Insight with Haslinda Amin, a daily news program featuring in-depth, high-profile interviews and analysis to give viewers the complete picture on the stories that matter. The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Insight with Haslinda Amin Begins
00:01:18 - Iran, US trade tanker attacks as Tehran warns of restricted zone
00:01:52 - Tech shares lead gains in Asian stocks, oil rises
00:05:21 - StashAway CIO Stephanie Leung on earnings supporting the equity rally
00:13:16 - China injects $45 billion in banks, insurers to boost growth
00:16:04 - Stephanie Leung on how fresh capital could support China’s economy
00:24:15 - Bond traders gird for more swings at both ends of US yield curve
00:27:08 - Maybank Asset Management's Rachana Mehta on income opportunities in Asia bonds
00:28:36 - Gamma Asset Management's Rajeev De Mello on investors shifting toward EM bonds
00:42:43 -  German far-right scores best result ever in state election
